runtimeCapability.description: A runtime capability: an opaque secret held by the execution host and stored by the service only as SHA-256. It is bound to one project, executor resource and runtime unit, and it is not a member identity.

mediaBridgeCapability.description: The media bridge's capability: an opaque secret on the bridge host; the API holds only its SHA-256. It names no member and grants no member authority: tool calls act for the speaker the exchange's input epoch binds, under that speaker's own role.

renderRunnerCapability.description: A render runner capability: an opaque secret held by the supervisor on the renderer host; the service stores only its SHA-256. It claims, reads, uploads and settles render jobs under their leases, and nothing else: no member, project or runtime authority.

title.description: The artifact's title (at most 180 characters, held by the database).

versionNumber.description: 1 for the first version of the artifact, then 2, 3… Omitted for a version written before numbering.

renditions.description: Other formats of this version, e.g. the PDF of a report's Markdown. Omitted when there is none.

changeNote.description: What changed from the previous version, in a sentence. Omitted for a first version and before notes existed.

retainedNote.description: What this version carried over from the previous one. Omitted for a first version.

limitations.description: What the version says it could not do. Omitted when it says nothing.

renditionOnly.description: The version adds a PDF its parent could not produce (Try PDF again, 0032): the same text and sources.

changeFacts.description: What the service computed about this version at publication (the chips come from these, never from the notes). Omitted for a version published before M03 S4.

trigger.description: What produced this version: a research task, or a rendition of the task's report (Try PDF again, with its render job). Omitted when unknown.

SourceContent.description: One authorized read of a source. Exactly one of text (a text kept inline) and downloadUrl (stored bytes, until expiresAt) is set.

filename.description: What a saved copy is called, e.g. sandboxed-pdf-rendering-v2.pdf.

text.description: The source itself, when it is a text kept inline.

route.description: The route admission chose (a create only). The bridge requires it to be the route its runtime unit maps to the role.

roles.description: The specialist roles this runtime's unit carries, each with its route and preset digest. Research is admitted only onto a ready runtime that advertises the specialist and its route; absent means none.

artifactId.description: The report this task writes into. Omitted until it has one, and always for a brief.

cacheReadTokens.description: Input tokens the provider read from its prompt cache. Omitted when the provider did not report it.

cacheWriteTokens.description: Input tokens the provider wrote to its prompt cache. Omitted when the provider did not report it.

outputs.description: What the task published: each stored format of the report version it produced. Omitted for a brief.

limitations.description: What the output says it could not do, in short sentences.

kind.description: The task's kind (draft_brief, research, …). A bridge announces the kinds it knows and leaves any other result unannounced.

inputMode.description: Bridge-derived admitted input mode; never taken from model arguments. Omitted by older bridges means voice.

expectedAffected.description: What the member's preview listed, in its order: the version ids, and each decision's id with the revision shown (a decision's revision moves whenever its state changes). Required: the withdrawal erases only if that is still exactly what it reaches, at those revisions, and answers a stale conflict otherwise.

previewToken.description: The preview's proof, as the preview returned it: the server showed this member exactly this list for this note. A list built without a preview, or another member's or note's proof, is refused; an expired one is a stale conflict.

MissionWithdrawalPreview.description: What forgetting this note would erase for everyone, computed by the same rule the withdrawal then applies: the note's versions, from the reader's own earliest wording in its history (an admin's: its first version) to its latest, and every proposal or decision citing any of them. The ledger may move before the member confirms; the withdrawal must send this list back as `expectedAffected` (the version ids, and each decision's id and revision) with this `previewToken`, and answers a stale conflict instead of erasing anything not shown, or in a state not shown.

previewToken.description: The server's proof that it showed this member this list for this note: an HMAC under a key only the database holds, of the member, the project, the note, the expiry and the reach (ids and revisions, never text). The withdrawal must carry it

expiresAt.description: When previewToken stops being accepted: 15 minutes after the preview

entries.description: The note's versions that would be forgotten, oldest first, with their words

decisions.description: The proposals and decisions citing any of them, oldest first, with every field of their words

ArtifactRendition.description: One stored format of an artifact version. Its bytes are the source's; the hash is what a download is checked against.

ArtifactVersionList.description: Every version of one artifact the reader may see, newest first.

ReportCard.description: One report as Knowledge lists it: what it is, where it lives, and its latest change.

projects.description: Each readable project with reports matching the format and search, and how many.

attemptId.description: As on every runtime call (RuntimeObservation); the service requires the attempt it bound.

roster.description: The disclosure guard's roster as far as the database holds it (member invitation addresses, lobby names). The bridge keeps it from the model.

attemptId.description: As on every runtime call (RuntimeObservation); the service requires the attempt it bound.

callId.description: The native tool-call id (or, for a model call, the bridge's provider call id); with the native session it is the operation's idempotency key.

purpose.description: partial_result only for the model call that writes the partial result; the bridge sets it from the attempt's finalize step, never from a tool argument.

attemptId.description: As on every runtime call (RuntimeObservation); the service requires the attempt it bound.

title.description: The page title the extractor reported (a read).

attemptId.description: As on every runtime call (RuntimeObservation); the service requires the attempt it bound.

callId.description: The native tool-call id (or, for a model call, the bridge's provider call id); with the native session it is the operation's idempotency key.

draftSha256.description: The draft being published: the one research_read_context last showed.

resultSummary.description: What the result resolves, for the guide and the work card.

changeNote.description: What changed; required from the second version on.

retainedNote.description: What was kept from the previous version.

citations.description: The sources the report cites: each one the task may read.

attemptId.description: As on every runtime call (RuntimeObservation); the service requires the attempt it bound.

callId.description: The native tool-call id; with the native session it is the submit's idempotency key.

ResearchSubmitRequest.description: Exactly one of result and blocker.

problems.description: notes_rejected: where the notes contradict the facts. Correct them and submit again; a second contradiction publishes with notes written from the facts.

notesFromFacts.description: published: the notes were written from the facts after the model's still contradicted them.

pdf.description: A PDF task's PDF: produced (a succeeded render of exactly the published draft, now the version's rendition) or not_produced, with the reason.

pdfReason.description: A PDF task published without its PDF: why, in one sentence (at most 300 characters, held by the database) the service wrote from the facts: not rendered, rendered from an earlier draft, or the render's failure. Omitted otherwise.

pdfRendering.description: True while a rendition ("Try PDF again") of the task's report is queued or rendering. Omitted otherwise.

ResearchProgress.description: A research task's request and progress: its allowance (committed counts what is reserved, spent or uncertain) and its source policy's use. Omitted for a brief.

ResearchRenderRequest.description: research_render_pdf: render the attempt's current draft (the one the model last read) as the task's PDF. The service prints it with the pdf-report-v1 template; the request carries no markup.

attemptId.description: As on every runtime call (RuntimeObservation); the service requires the attempt it bound.

callId.description: The native tool-call id (or, for a model call, the bridge's provider call id); with the native session it is the operation's idempotency key.

language.description: The report's language (BCP 47); en when omitted.

ResearchRenderResultRequest.description: research_inspect_output: a render of this task, the latest when none is named.

attemptId.description: As on every runtime call (RuntimeObservation); the service requires the attempt it bound.

ReportManifest.description: The report's manifest (report_manifest_v1), derived from its Markdown by the pdf-report-v1 template and checked before it renders.

RenderResult.description: sophia.render-result.v1 (the pack's render contract): a settled render's record, a view of the kernel's receipt. In a task, sourceVersionId is the draft the render printed.

ResearchRender.description: A render of the task's PDF as the research tools see it. rejected: the report failed its manifest checks (reportChecks) and nothing was queued; revise the draft. queued and rendering: wait. succeeded: pdf is the output. failed or cancelled: reason, errorCode and the kernel's checks say why.

ResearchRendition.description: "Try PDF again": the rendition queued for a published report without its PDF (queued, rendering, or how an earlier call with the same key ended), or rejected with the report's checks when the version cannot be printed.

ReportSections.description: Sections by heading, from the stored Markdown of this version and the previous one. A first version's are all added.

kind.description: A search's result list (snippets only), a page read in full or in part by the extractor, or an input the project admitted.

originHttpStatus.description: Null when unknown: the extractor reports only its own status.

RenderJob.description: One claimed render: its lease and its source package, each file by relative path and SHA-256. Files are fetched through the API under the lease.

RenderReceipt.description: The PDF kernel's receipt (renderers/web/pdf, sophia.pdf-render-receipt.v1): what it rendered, how it was confined, and every check, passed, failed or unknown.
